detail.longDescription: 🆕 MCPRack v1.4.0 News: • Admin manages the configuration for the user - a non-technical user does not have to log in at all, the admin sets up access, server selection and individual data from the website or via CLI. • Installation of servers directly from PyPI / npm / Docker via Admin → Install, each in an isolated environment. • Self-registration of servers during apt install - the MCP server in the Debian package registers itself with mcprack, without a manual step by the admin. • Growing family of ready-made MCP servers: AbraFlexi, MultiFlexi, Mastodon, LinkedIn, Nextcloud, Zabbix, NetBox, Datovka (ISDS), Redmine, Selenium and others. 📦 Available as a .deb package (VitexSoftware APT repo) and on PyPI (pip install mcprack). Open source under the MIT license. 👉 Try the live demo and check out GitHub: 🔗 https:// github.com/VitexSoftware/mcpra ck # MCP # ModelContextProtocol # AI # DevOps # OpenSource # Python # Flask # ClaudeDesktop # GitHubCopilot # SelfHosted # Vaultwarden # OpenTelemetry
